title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025 NOV)
summary: The post lists numerous feature ideas and enhancement suggestions for Dynamics 365 Business Central from November 2025, covering areas such as Copilot integration, financial management, inventory, manufacturing, sales, and localization. It serves as a compilation of community-submitted ideas for potential improvements across various business processes.
key_points: Community members submitted ideas spanning multiple systems including finance, sales, inventory, manufacturing, and administration
Several ideas address development capabilities like variadic parameters, translation methods, and event expansion in core codeunits
Localization improvements include native verifactu implementation for Spain (available January 2026) and SEPA file enhancements for Germany
Financial management ideas focus on cash flow projections, exchange rate handling, consolidation features, and intercompany transactions
Warehouse and manufacturing improvements target reservation handling, subcontracting processes, and item-related functionality
